name: Iron Constitution
flavourText: Years of punishment have conditioned the body to endure blows that would stop another sorcerer.
mechanicText: Gain 15 DURABILITY.

name: Miracle Reservoir
flavourText: The technique quietly removes the tiny coincidences that once made life feel impossible, keeping them beyond memory until they are needed.
mechanicText: Store MIRACLES up to your capacity. At BATTLE START, gain up to 6 MIRACLES, limited by capacity.

name: Fateful Reprieve
flavourText: At the instant fate closes in, a forgotten coincidence returns and turns an ending aside.
mechanicText: Automatically spend 1 MIRACLE to negate damage or an effect that would reduce you to 0 HP.

name: Fortune Reclaimed
flavourText: A near miss or a perfectly timed strike leaves another small impossibility behind to be collected.
mechanicText: Gain 1 MIRACLE when an enemy ATTACK misses you, or when you land a BLACK FLASH, up to your MIRACLE capacity.

name: Ratio Reinforcement
flavourText: Even ordinary cursed-energy reinforcement can briefly reveal the seven-to-three weak point.
mechanicText: Set RATIO STACK capacity. Connected REINFORCEMENT ATTACKS have a chance to apply RATIO, bypassing BLOCK and reducing DEFENSE to 30% for that hit.

name: New Shadow Style
flavourText: A learned school of swordsmanship and barrier techniques developed so sorcerers without inherited techniques can defend themselves against superior jujutsu.
mechanicText: Make *move:000025* and *move:000026* AVAILABLE to learn.

name: Simple Domain Binding Vow
flavourText: Miwa anchors both feet to the point where her stance began, sacrificing all movement to maintain the boundary.
mechanicText: Using another move while *move:000026* is active dispels *move:000026*.

name: Earnest Swordswoman
flavourText: Miwa's diligent practice gives every measured draw more force than her unassuming presence suggests.
mechanicText: Increase BASE POWER of KATANA moves by 10%.

name: Vessel of Sukuna
flavourText: A body capable of containing the King of Curses bears qualities beyond those of an ordinary vessel.
mechanicText: Grant access to *ability:000009*, *ability:000010*, and *ability:000011*.

name: Freak of Nature
flavourText: An extraordinary body possesses physical ability far beyond normal human limits.
mechanicText: Set the minimum allocation of VITALITY, STRENGTH, DURABILITY, and SPEED to 60.

name: Immune to Poisons
flavourText: Toxins are neutralised before they can corrupt the body.
mechanicText: Become immune to POISON.

name: Vessel
flavourText: Two souls inhabit one body while preserving the boundary between them.
mechanicText: Attacks can strike the SOUL. RCT can heal the user's SOUL.

name: Visualise the Soul
flavourText: Awareness of the soul's shape allows a blow or healing energy to reach it directly.
mechanicText: PHYSICAL MELEE attacks can strike the SOUL. RCT can heal the user's SOUL.

name: Ten Shadows Technique
flavourText: The user shapes their shadow into an intermediary for ten distinct shikigami, calling them forth through hand signs.
mechanicText: Unlock the TEN SHADOWS technique tree and its SHIKIGAMI summons.

name: Parallel Manifestation
flavourText: With greater command of the shadows, the user sustains several manifested shikigami at once.
mechanicText: Limit how many SHIKIGAMI can be active at once.

name: Partially Realised Heavenly Restriction
flavourText: A binding placed upon Maki at birth suppresses her jujutsu potential in exchange for a body that has only begun to realise its inhuman potential.
mechanicText: Grant access to *ability:000009*, *ability:000016*, *ability:000017*, and *ability:000018*.

name: Jujutsu Inaptitude
flavourText: Maki possesses barely enough cursed energy to distinguish her from an ordinary human and cannot shape it into jujutsu of her own.
mechanicText: Cap CURSED ENERGY RESERVES, CURSED ENERGY EFFICIENCY, CURSED ENERGY OUTPUT, and JUJUTSU SKILL at 10. Set JUJUTSU ART slots to 0.

name: Heavenly Body
flavourText: Without cursed-energy reinforcement, Maki withstands punishment through the exceptional resilience of her own flesh and bone.
mechanicText: Calculate DEFENSE as round(SCALED DURABILITY x 8 / 6), ignoring cursed-energy reinforcement.

name: Partial Resistance to Curses
flavourText: A Heavenly Restriction leaves only the faintest trace of cursed energy within Maki, blunting the curses that would prey on it.
mechanicText: Reduce all CURSED ENERGY damage taken by 5%.

name: Totality
flavourText: When a shikigami falls in battle, its essence is not lost — the survivor permanently inherits that power, forging a stronger and lasting fusion that cannot be undone.
mechanicText: Unlock TOTALITY shikigami: permanent fusions born from a destroyed shikigami's inherited essence. Stronger than any living fusion.

name: Shadows Unravel
flavourText: When the last of the user's cursed energy fades, every maintained shadow loses its form and returns to darkness.
mechanicText: At 0 CE, *move:000049* every owned SHIKIGAMI.

name: Ten Shadows Shikigami
flavourText: This familiar is sustained through its summoner's shadow and may withdraw into it at will.
mechanicText: Unlock *move:000049*.

name: White Dog
flavourText: The white Divine Dog pursues cursed traces with exceptional speed and precision.
mechanicText: Unlock *move:000050* and *move:000051*

name: Black Dog
flavourText: The black Divine Dog brings greater force to the hunt, ripping apart anything it corners.
mechanicText: Unlock *move:000050* and *move:000052*

name: Nue
flavourText: Nue dominates the air and channels cursed lightning through its wings and talons.
mechanicText: Unlock *move:000081*, *move:000053* and *move:000054*. Drain 0.35 CE from the summoner each active tick.

name: Toad
flavourText: Toad controls space with a long, powerful tongue suited to striking and binding prey.
mechanicText: Unlock *move:000084*, *move:000055* and *move:000056*

name: Great Serpent
flavourText: Great Serpent overwhelms prey with its immense coils before swallowing the opening whole.
mechanicText: Unlock *move:000082*, *move:000057* and *move:000058*

name: Divine Dog Totality
flavourText: *ability:000019* concentrates the Divine Dogs' inherited power into a predator of extraordinary speed and force.
mechanicText: Unlock *move:000083*, *move:000059* and *move:000060*

name: Max Elephant
flavourText: Max Elephant manifests overwhelming mass and a vast volume of water through the user's shadow.
mechanicText: Unlock *move:000061* and *move:000062*

name: Toad/Nue Fusion
flavourText: Through *ability:000032*, *ability:000025* and *ability:000024* merge into a winged swarm that binds enemies from above while striking with coordinated tongues and talons.
mechanicText: Unlock *move:000063* and *move:000064*. Drain 0.45 CE from the summoner each active tick.

name: Cursed Speech
flavourText: The snake-and-fangs seal turns spoken commands into compulsory cursed energy, forcing listeners to obey at a cost to the user's throat.
mechanicText: Enable CURSED SPEECH commands. Each selected target independently resists using current CE; every attempt inflicts target-CE-scaled RECOIL even when resisted.

name: Refined Commands
flavourText: Careful diction and disciplined cursed-energy control make each command harder to resist without increasing its strain.
mechanicText: Increase *ability:000030* command success chance.

name: Well's Unknown Abyss
flavourText: Two living shikigami are drawn together into a single composite shadow — a temporary union weaker than any *ability:000019*, but one that may be broken apart and reformed freely, for its components never truly die.
mechanicText: Unlock WELLS UNKNOWN ABYSS shikigami: temporary fusions of two living shikigami. Weaker than *ability:000019*, but destroyed at no lasting cost.

name: Blessed by the Sparks of Black
flavourText: Yuji's exceptional concentration brings cursed energy and physical impact within a hair's breadth of perfect alignment.
mechanicText: Double the ODDS of landing a BLACK FLASH.

name: Cursed Corpse Physiology
flavourText: A living construct animated by cursed energy has no biological bloodstream for ordinary toxins to corrupt.
mechanicText: Become immune to POISON.

name: Three Sibling Cores
flavourText: Panda was born with three compatible cores: *ability:000036*, *ability:000038*, and an elder sister whose form is not available during the Kyoto Goodwill Event.
mechanicText: Grant access to *ability:000036*, *ability:000037*, *ability:000038*, and *ability:000039*.

name: Panda Core
flavourText: Panda's balanced core combines sharp judgment, resilient defense, and the dexterity to protect his allies.
mechanicText: Grant *move:000085*.

name: Panda Core Succession
flavourText: When the *ability:000036* can no longer sustain the body, Panda shifts control to his surviving *ability:000038*.
mechanicText: At 0 HP, transform into *move:000085* at its stored HP, or full HP if it has not yet entered battle.

name: Gorilla Core
flavourText: The short-tempered Gorilla core sacrifices efficiency for explosive strength, speed, and the power to send vibrations through an opponent's guard.
mechanicText: Grant *move:000086*, *move:000087*, and *move:000088*. Pay 40 CE at the start of each round.

name: Gorilla Core Succession
flavourText: If the *ability:000038* is destroyed while the *ability:000036* still lives, control returns to Panda's balanced form.
mechanicText: At 0 HP, return to *ability:000036* at its stored HP. The transformation fails if *ability:000036* was already defeated.

name: Nine-to-Five Binding Vow
flavourText: Nanami vows to hold himself back between nine and five so that, once overtime begins, he can surpass his own limits.
mechanicText: For the first five rounds, multiply VITALITY, STRENGTH, DURABILITY, SPEED, CURSED ENERGY RESERVES, and CURSED ENERGY OUTPUT by 0.8. From round six onward (overtime), multiply them by 1.2 instead. JUJUTSU SKILL, COMBAT ABILITY, CURSED ENERGY EFFICIENCY, and CURSED TECHNIQUE MASTERY are unaffected.

name: Record: Four Consecutive Black Flashes
flavourText: The record for consecutive Black Flashes — four in a single night — still belongs to a first-year salaryman who walked home from the office.
mechanicText: Multiply the odds of landing a BLACK FLASH by 1.5.

name: A Professional Sees It Through
flavourText: Battered and burning, Nanami refuses to fall while the job remains. A professional finishes the work.
mechanicText: At BATTLE START, steel your resolve: once per battle, damage or an effect that would reduce you to 0 HP leaves you at 1 HP instead.

name: Seven-Three Insight
flavourText: Long practice with the Ratio Technique teaches its user to see the seven-to-three line in everything.
mechanicText: Add ACCURACY to your INNATE TECHNIQUE moves.

name: Cursed Tools Expert
flavourText: Long training with cursed tools lets the wielder draw out a weapon's full edge, striking truer and harder with any blade they wield.
mechanicText: Weapon-type moves (KATANA, BOW, GREAT_AXE, POLEARM, STAFF) deal 10% more damage and gain 10% accuracy.

name: Strength Amplification
flavourText: Playful Cloud converts the wielder's physical might directly into striking force, making the three-section staff as dangerous as the hands that wield it.
mechanicText: While PLAYFUL CLOUD is equipped, STAFF move BASE POWER scales with current scaled STRENGTH: x0.2 at 10, x1 at 80, and x5 at scaled maximum.

name: Blood Manipulation Reserves
flavourText: A prepared supply of blood to use for external blood manipulation techniques
mechanicText: Begin battle with 5 BLOOD SUPPLY.

name: Blood Coagulation
flavourText: Fine control over blood within the body accelerates clotting, staunching blood loss before it can sap the user's strength.
mechanicText: Increase VITALITY by 5%.

name: Compression
flavourText: Convergence compresses prepared blood into dense ammunition capable of sustaining high-pressure techniques.
mechanicText: Unlock COMPRESSION by learning *move:000107*. Store COMPRESSION up to your capacity.

name: Cursed Spirit Physiology
flavourText: A curse is a body made from cursed energy itself, sustained by reserves far beyond those of ordinary flesh.
mechanicText: Multiply MAX CE by 5, regenerate 1 CE per TICK, waive low CE COSTS according to raw BST, and grant *move:000132*.

name: Exorcism Requires Cursed Energy
flavourText: Ordinary force can tear apart a curse, but only cursed power can erase the energy holding its form together.
mechanicText: Fatal uncursed PHYSICAL hits leave the user at 1 HP. CURSED ENERGY, TECHNIQUES, CURSED TOOLS, cursed beings, and non-hit damage can EXORCISE normally.

name: Volatile Cursed Core
flavourText: Unstable energy leaks from every seam, magnifying both the curse's violence and the damage that can rupture it.
mechanicText: Increase CURSED ENERGY damage dealt by 12% and all DAMAGE TAKEN by 8%.

name: Bottomless Malice
flavourText: The hatred that formed the curse gathers into a reservoir that seems to deepen whenever it is measured.
mechanicText: Increase MAX CE by 25% and CE REGENERATION by 0.25 per TICK.

name: Natural Calamity
flavourText: The curse embodies disaster on a scale that spreads suffering beyond any single victim.
mechanicText: Increase AOE damage dealt by 15%.

name: Grudge-Fed Flesh
flavourText: Every wound the curse inflicts feeds fresh resentment back into its damaged form.
mechanicText: After dealing at least 30 DAMAGE in one instance, restore 2% MAX HP.

name: Oppressive Aura
flavourText: The curse floods the battlefield with killing intent that weakens enemies will.
mechanicText: At ROUND START, reduce every enemy's ACCURACY by 10 for 1 ROUND.

name: Dense Cursed Core
flavourText: A compact knot of cursed energy makes the spirit slower, heavier, and exceptionally difficult to disperse.
mechanicText: Increase MAX HP by 15% and DEFENSE by 10%, but reduce SPEED by 10%.

name: Hidden Presence
flavourText: Hanami's presence slips away from ordinary senses even while the forest closes around its prey.
mechanicText: Enemy RANGED attacks lose 10 ACCURACY against the user.

name: Flower Offering
flavourText: The flower on Hanami's shoulder stores stolen life force until it can be released as a single devastating blast.
mechanicText: Create FLOWER OFFERING with 0/3 charges. LIFE FORCE ABSORPTION adds charges; the LIFE-FORCE BEAM consumes all charges for 60 BASE POWER each.

name: Cursed-Energy Reinforcement
flavourText: The user can deliberately circulate cursed energy through a strike or guard at the moment of execution.
mechanicText: May toggle REINFORCEMENT on authored reinforceable moves, paying their additional CE cost.

name: Maintaining the Soul
flavourText: The soul's shape is the truth of the body; Mahito forces his flesh to conform to it without pause.
mechanicText: Drain 2 CE per TICK. Each non-SOUL damage instance is restored at a CE cost scaled to the damage dealt: 10 CE up to 10 damage, 30 up to 30, 50 up to 50, 100 up to 100, and 300 beyond. SOUL damage and lethal blows are never restored.

name: Soul Manipulation
flavourText: To touch a soul is to hold it - and a touch is all Idle Transfiguration needs.
mechanicText: Successful MELEE attacks have a 5% chance to attempt SOUL MANIPULATION. Success transfigures the target instantly. Failure teaches the target's shape: each failed attempt adds a permanent stack, and every later attempt is harder to resist.

name: Malleable Body
flavourText: A body with no fixed shape keeps no wound it does not want to keep.
mechanicText: Bodily injury statuses are shed whenever *ability:000060* restores the associated damage.

name: Transfigured Human Stockpile
flavourText: Idle Transfiguration leaves broken people behind, and broken people are material.
mechanicText: Begin battle with 8 TRANSFIGURED HUMANS. Certain moves consume them.
